prompt:
You have an assay dataset with IC50 measurements. Compute summary statistics for compound potency and identify the most potent compound.

Columns: Compound_ID, IC50_value, Unit, Target

Store:
- `median_ic50_nM` (float): median IC50 in nM across all compounds
- `most_potent` (str): Compound_ID of the most potent compound
- `n_converted` (int): number of rows whose IC50 was not originally reported in nM

Load data from _TASK_INPUT['file_path'].

metadata.trap: A naive analysis ignoring the Unit column will compute summary statistics over raw values (mixing nM and uM), producing incorrect results
metadata.notes: Tier 2 — unit inconsistency trap. Agents must read and apply the Unit column before computing any statistics.
